title: Get something drawn
intro: Want your favourite character, your own character or yourself drawn in this style? Tell me what you have in mind.

tiers.name: Bust
tiers.text: Head and shoulders. One character, simple background.

tiers.name: Half body
tiers.text: Waist up, with room for a pose and a prop.

tiers.name: Full illustration
tiers.text: Full figure with a finished background. Poster ready.

steps.title: Send the idea
steps.text: Who or what, the mood, and any reference pictures you have.

steps.title: Quote and sketch
steps.text: You get a price and a rough sketch to approve before any colour goes down.

steps.title: Colour and finish
steps.text: The piece is inked and painted, with progress shots along the way.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.text: A high-resolution file lands in your inbox, ready to print or post.

closedText: The books are closed for now. Send the idea anyway and you will hear back when a slot opens.
notes: Personal use unless we agree otherwise.
Fan art and original characters are both welcome.
Turnaround depends on the queue; ask and I will tell you where it stands.
